verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an agent framework, since agent memory, run traces and agent definitions are user data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no first-party feature that exports all user data in open formats. Programmatic memory access, OpenTelemetry instrumentation of runs and push_to_hub sharing are building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented data-export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
